title: Davao police seizes P3.3-M worth of suspected shabu; 4 arrested
summary: Davao Region Police arrested four alleged drug personalities in separate anti-illegal drug operations in Davao del Sur and Davao City and seized approximately P3.3 million worth of suspected shabu.
